preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Input consists of a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10) followed by n integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ 1000) representing the number of balloons in each packet.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.split()[0] == 'k' and k := int(stdout.split()[0]) and 1 <= k <= n - 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()[1:]) and set(stdout.split()[1:]) == set(stdout.split()[1:]) and sum(int(a) for a in stdin.split()[1:][int(x)-1 for x in stdout.split()[1:]]) != sum(int(a) for a in stdin.split()[1:][int(x)-1 for x in [str(i) for i in range(1, n+1) if str(i) not in stdout.split()[1:]]) and len(set(stdout.split()[1:])) == len(stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If a valid distribution exists, output k (1 ≤ k ≤ n-1) followed by k distinct packet indices (1 ≤ index ≤ n) such that the sum of balloons in Grigory's packets is not equal to the sum in Andrew's packets. Otherwise, output -1.
